title: Jovial Moissonneuse - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Jovial Moissonneuse in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: One of the three masks connected to the Axon in Visages, and one of the three Vale bosses that feed Mask Keeper's extra abilities. Defeating it before the main fight directly removes one of those buffs.

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Jovial Moissonneuse
sections.content:
What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
